product.title: Take a thrilling 85 Miles Private Helicopter Tour to Space Coast

description.text: Take a private helicopter tour from Kissimmee over Orlando's theme-park corridor and onward to the Space Coast with views toward Port Canaveral and Cape Canaveral. In-flight commentary and taxes included for this premium aerial day trip beyond the theme parks. Stops include MaxFlight Helicopter Services Inc., Space Coast, Port Canaveral. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Central Florida's wildlife, coastlines, and space-coast sights. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
